% A sample that lands on an explicit limit up to float noise (x = -3.8 + 12*5.2/24
% = -1.2) counts for the other direction's automatic range (behaviour Z16,
% shrunk from a generator-fuzz case).
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xmin=-1.2, xmax=1.3]
\addplot[domain=-3.8:1.4] {x^2};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
